I would strongly advise people to avoid this place for any Apple-related repairs.

I visited yesterday to get my iPhone battery replaced and was quoted ₹9,800, which seemed unusually high. Fortunately, the battery wasn’t available at the time, so I decided to check another service centre.

I then went to Unicorn in Andheri West (opposite Laxmi Industrial Estate), which is an Apple-authorised service centre. featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely disappointing experience at iVenus Apple Premium Reseller.

I purchased my iPhone 17 in October, and since the beginning the camera button had issues. After the latest software update, the issue became much worse and the camera started opening randomly without any input.

I visited the store on Sunday and was told the issue was repairable under warranty, but I was asked to return on Monday because the service staff was unavailable.

The next day, the service representative suddenly claimed my phone had “physical damage” and quoted me around ₹35,000 for repair. Strangely, during the same visit, they ran diagnostics on my phone and confirmed that it passed all tests successfully with no physical damage being detected, making me eligible for AppleCare+.

As per Apple’s own policy, physically damaged phones are not eligible for AppleCare+, which directly contradicts what I was being told.

I was then advised to purchase AppleCare+ for ₹8,500 along with an additional ₹5,000 for replacement charges. I was even specifically advised NOT to visit an official Apple Store.

Thankfully, I decided to get a second opinion directly from Apple. To my surprise, Apple repaired the issue completely FREE OF COST within 2 hours with no mention of physical damage, no ₹35,000 repair, and no paid replacement required.

This entire experience felt extremely misleading and unethical. Very disappointing from an Apple-authorized reseller. Customers should be careful and always seek a second opinion before agreeing to expensive repairs or unnecessary purchases.
